_meta.source: Seeded from venues named in data/trainings.json; details migrated from the anft.earth immersion pages (2026-08)
_meta.notes: Each training/event references a venue by venue_id. internalContact.* (phone, email) is INTERNAL ONLY and must never render on a public page. Lodging *options* live on the venue; lodging *cost* lives on the event (lodgingCost). Latitude/longitude and internal contacts are left empty pending real values; do not invent them.

venues.name: Dharma Centre of Canada
venues.description: A meditation centre on 400 acres of boreal forest in the ancient Canadian Shield — wetlands, lakes, ponds, streams and mixed coniferous–deciduous forest, home to deer, moose, bald eagles and owls. The bedrock beneath dates back roughly 1.3 billion years.
venues.howToGetThere: 1267 Galway Road, Kinmount K0M 2A0, Ontario. Car or carpool is recommended; the nearest bus station is Fenelon Falls. A private driver service is available from Peterborough (about $50 one-way per passenger).

lodgingOptions.name: Forest rooms
lodgingOptions.description: Rustic single bedrooms set throughout the forested property, with shared bathrooms. Three vegetarian meals daily, often from the centre's own gardens, served buffet style; dietary needs accommodated with notice. Lodging and meals must be booked through the venue — no off-site accommodation is permitted; a booking link is sent after tuition is paid.

venues.seasonalWeather: Late August and early September bring warm, ideal late-summer conditions.

accessibility.facilities: Hiking trails throughout the property and canoe/kayak access to Union Lake. Wi-Fi in the Tea House and Main House only — not in the accommodations. No intoxicants permitted on the property.

venues.name: Just Love Forest
venues.description: A 716-acre forest sanctuary in the Appalachian foothills with a 30-foot gathering yurt, three forest-therapy trails (easy, moderate and intensive), two outdoor fire circles and an eight-circle stone labyrinth. It runs on off-grid solar power, with indoor and outdoor kitchens.
venues.howToGetThere: Lyerly, Georgia. About 90 minutes from Atlanta and its airport, and 60 minutes from Chattanooga airport.

lodgingOptions.name: Deluxe bell tent
lodgingOptions.description: Canvas glamping tent with a queen bed.

lodgingOptions.name: Teepee-style tent
lodgingOptions.description: Smaller glamping tent with twin beds.

accessibility.facilities: Fresh linens provided; eco composting toilets and hot outdoor showers. Training participants stay on-site only.

venues.name: Baba Ecolodge
venues.description: An eco-resort on Ko Phra Thong island in south-western Thailand, beside a national park — a 12 km private beach, virgin jungle, mangrove streams, a protected bay of shallow clear water and Thailand's only savannah ecosystem, with macaques, hornbills, green turtles and white-bellied sea eagles.
venues.howToGetThere: Nearest airport is Phuket International. From Phuket it is a 2.5–3 hour car transfer to Kuraburi Pier, then a 90-minute longtail boat to the island — the only way in.

lodgingOptions.name: Thai wooden villas
lodgingOptions.description: Traditional villas with private gardens and elevated decks, from one-bedroom beachfront units to family villas; king or queen beds. Camping is not permitted.

venues.seasonalWeather: Tropical, on the Andaman Sea. Buildings rely on natural sea breezes and ceiling fans rather than air conditioning.

venues.name: Casa Portal
venues.description: A 100-acre retreat centre on a working sheep farm, dedicated to slow living and nature connection: an 1840s farmhouse, woodland trails, sheep meadows, a swimming pond, gardens, a fibre-arts shed and an apple orchard, in woods of pine, birch, hemlock, maple, fir, beech and spruce.
venues.howToGetThere: 83 Sullivan Road, Jackson, Maine 04921. About 40 minutes from Bangor International Airport, 2 hours from Portland and 3 hours from Boston; 20 minutes from Belfast. Concord Trailways bus from Boston or Portland; paid car service from Bangor, Portland or Belfast.

accessibility.terrain: Trails offer both flat and hilly options.
accessibility.facilities: Shared single-stall bathrooms and outdoor showers; solar-powered accommodations. Cell service available; limited Wi-Fi in the main house only. Screened porch, library, sunroom and workshop barn.

venues.name: Well Being Retreat Center
venues.description: 160 acres bordered by two miles of the Powell River in eastern Tennessee's Cumberland Mountains. Low-impact buildings — cabins set into the hillsides, some earth-sheltered and built around existing trees — plus a conference centre, a covered riverside pavilion, a meditation hall, a labyrinth, a fire pit and a library.
venues.howToGetThere: Tazewell, Tennessee — about 50 miles (1.5 hours) north of Knoxville; roughly 2 hours from Lexington KY, 2.25 hours from Asheville NC, 3 hours from Chattanooga and 4 hours from Nashville.

lodgingOptions.name: Cabins / tiny houses
lodgingOptions.description: Eleven cabins of varying sizes, single or double occupancy.

lodgingOptions.name: Riverbank camping
lodgingOptions.description: Camping on the river banks, with climate-controlled facilities nearby.

accessibility.terrain: Steep, heavily vegetated terrain with uneven, sometimes slippery ground; gravel roads with slopes take vehicles, and the property is walkable via roads and built trails.
accessibility.facilities: Wi-Fi at the conference centre and meditation hut; Verizon is the most reliable cell carrier.

venues.name: Hotel Tosco Romagnolo
venues.description: A hotel in the spa town of Bagno di Romagna, in the Apennine mountains of Emilia-Romagna.
venues.howToGetThere: Via del Popolo 2, 47021 Bagno di Romagna (FC). Bologna airport (BLQ) is about 1.5 hours by car via the A14/E45 and is recommended for travellers from the US; Florence (FLR) is about 1.75 hours on a scenic mountain road. Forlì (55 km), Rimini (74 km) and Florence (96 km) airports are nearer. By train, take high-speed rail to Cesena, then regional bus line 138 (about 1 h 10). Private transfers are available from Bologna or Florence.

lodgingOptions.name: Hotel rooms (bed & breakfast)
lodgingOptions.description: Rooms at the hotel on a bed-and-breakfast basis for immersion participants.

venues.name: Rocky Mountain Ecodharma Retreat Center
venues.description: A retreat centre on 180 acres of river, alpine meadow and spruce–aspen forest near the Indian Peaks Wilderness and adjacent to National Forest land, with deer, elk, moose, bear and beaver.
venues.howToGetThere: 1841 Overland Road, Ward, Colorado. About 1.5 hours by car from Denver International Airport. A $10 bus runs airport-to-Boulder, then rideshare to the venue; carpooling is coordinated. Note: there is no cell service at the venue, so Uber is unreliable for the return trip.

accessibility.facilities: No public Wi-Fi; a landline is available.

venues.name: Daintree Siesta
venues.description: A rainforest property in the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Daintree Rainforest of Tropical North Queensland, with exclusive rainforest walking trails and an on-site restaurant. Hosted by Tamara, a certified ANFT guide, and Bruce Scenna.
venues.howToGetThere: 1973 Cape Tribulation Rd, Diwan QLD 4873. About 2.5 hours' drive from Cairns on a sealed, scenic road that includes a car-ferry crossing. A shuttle van leaves Cairns CBD around 11:00 am on arrival day.

lodgingOptions.name: Camping
lodgingOptions.description: Powered and unpowered sites for tents, caravans and motorhomes.

venues.seasonalWeather: Warm, humid and possibly wet — this is the world's most ancient tropical rainforest.

venues.name: Lodge Kod Kod Study Center
venues.description: A study centre in temperate forest that combines eco-tourism with biological research, in the Liucura River valley at the foot of the El Cañi sanctuary, near Huerquehue and Villarrica national parks and with views of the Villarrica volcano. It has run as a wildlife-conservation study site for over a decade.
venues.howToGetThere: In La Araucanía, southern Chile — 21 km from Pucón on the road to Huife. Nearest airport is Temuco (fly in, then shuttle or taxi), or take a long-distance bus from Santiago to Pucón with onward transport; shared shuttles are coordinated.

lodgingOptions.name: Shared bedrooms
lodgingOptions.description: Five rooms with up to six single beds each, with fold-down cabin bunks and en-suite bathrooms with showers. On-site stays only.
